result.rationale: PSA International is a Singapore-headquartered global holdco, not a North America-focused company. It handled 105.0m TEU in 2025 across >70 terminals, >180 locations and 45 countries. Current North American port operations are Ashcroft, two PSA Halifax terminals and PSA Penn—four physical terminals/inland terminals, under 6% of the group terminal count—with no Mexico port. PSA BDP is Philadelphia-headquartered but global. Temasek remains the reported 100% owner.

identityResolution.boundary: Global investment/strategic holdco for PSA port, supply-chain and marine businesses. PSA Corporation Ltd is the Singapore commercial terminal operator beneath PSA International; port regulation sits with the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore.

ownershipResolution.history: PSA Corporation was Temasek-wholly-owned from 1997-10-01; PSA International became group holdco in 2003-12.
ownershipResolution.minorities: No PSA International minority shareholder is disclosed; subsidiary non-controlling interests are below PSAI.
ownershipResolution.governmentStatus: Indirect state ownership: Singapore's Minister for Finance is Temasek's sole shareholder; Temasek and PSA operate commercially.
ownershipResolution.temasek2026: Temasek Singapore began managing TPCs on 2026-04-01; no PSAI share transfer or dilution was disclosed.

operatingResolution.services: Deepsea, rail and inland terminals plus supply-chain, marine and digital services for carriers, cargo owners and logistics customers.

northAmerica.terminalCountIndicator: 4 physical terminals/inland terminals versus >70 group terminals (<6%)
northAmerica.disclosureGap: No North America-only throughput, revenue or EBITDA.

acquisitionExitCheck.search: PSA, Temasek, SGX/government and transaction sources searched through cutoff.
acquisitionExitCheck.result: No PSAI-level sale, listing, partial privatization, dilution, exit or signed transfer found; Temasek's latest disclosure remains 100%. Subsidiary transactions do not create separate Temasek manager holdings.

milestones.event: Port of Singapore Authority formed as statutory board.
PSA Corporation succeeded it as a Temasek-wholly-owned commercial company; regulation moved to MPA.
PSA International became the PSA Group's main global holdco.
Temasek Singapore began managing the TPC portfolio; no PSAI ownership transfer was announced.
